name: VRM_POL_IMMATERIAL_DETAILS_GT
description: Oracle internal use only. This global temporary table is used in identify customer contracts job during internal processing of immaterial change.

columns.name: POL_IMMATERIAL_DETAIL_ID
columns.description: Promised detail line level immaterial details unique identifier.

columns.name: FMV_LINE_ID
columns.description: Standalone selling price line unique identifier.

columns.name: CONTR_CUR_FMV_AMT
columns.description: Standalone selling price amount in the contract currency for the promised detail line.

columns.name: CONTR_CUR_ALLOCATED_AMT
columns.description: Allocated transaction price in the contract currency for the promised detail line.

columns.name: REVENUE_RULE_ID
columns.description: Satisfaction plan unique identifier.

columns.name: REVENUE_START_DATE
columns.description: The date the satisfaction plan begins.

columns.name: REVENUE_RULE_DURATION
columns.description: Number of periods in which the revenue of this performance obligation line is to be recognized.

columns.name: REVENUE_END_DATE
columns.description: The date the satisfaction plan ends.

columns.name: NET_QUANTITY
columns.description: Net quantity of a promised detail line.

columns.name: LATEST_REC_FLAG
columns.description: Latest immaterial change type that occurred on the promised detail line.

columns.name: CONTRACT_MODIFICATION_DATE
columns.description: Date on which the revenue contract was modified.

columns.name: IMMATERIAL_CHANGE_CODE
columns.description: Immaterial change type for this line. Valid values are from the lookup type ORA_IMMATERIAL_CHANGE_TYPE.

columns.name: EFFECTIVITY_PERIOD_ID
columns.description: Effective period unique identifier. Derived using the customer contract date.

columns.name: REMOVED_FLAG
columns.description: Indicates whether the current line is considered when computing the allocated amount on the promised detail line after processing an immaterial change.

columns.name: CONTR_CUR_MOD_DATE_REV_AMT
columns.description: Recognized revenue in the contract currency as of the contract revision date.

columns.name: SATISFACTION_BASE_PROPORTION
columns.description: Base number for the satisfaction schedule proportions. The default value is 100. The base number is updated when the schedule rows are updated.  The base number is the sum of the numerator of the ratio of all schedules.

columns.name: CONTR_CUR_PART_PERIOD_REV_AMT
columns.description: Recognized revenue in the contract currency as of the contract revision date in a partial accounting period.

columns.name: PERF_OBLIGATION_LINE_ID
columns.description: Performance obligation line unique identifier.

columns.name: PERF_OBLIGATION_ID
columns.description: Performance obligation unique identifier.

columns.name: CUSTOMER_CONTRACT_HEADER_ID
columns.description: Customer contract header unique identifier.

columns.name: PREVIOUS_SERVICE_DURATION
columns.description: Previous duration of the service item in terms of the service unit of measure.

columns.name: SERVICE_DURATION
columns.description: Duration of the service item in terms of the service unit of measure.

columns.name: ENTERED_CUR_FMV_AMT
columns.description: Standalone selling price amount in the entered currency for the promised detail line.

columns.name: ENTERED_CUR_ALLOCATED_AMT
columns.description: Allocated transaction price in the entered currency for the promised detail line.

columns.name: ENTERED_CUR_MOD_DATE_REV_AMT
columns.description: Recognized revenue in the entered currency as of the contract revision date.

columns.name: ENTERED_CUR_PART_PER_REV_AMT
columns.description: Recognized revenue in the entered currency as of the contract revision date in a partial accounting period.

columns.name: EXCHANGE_RATE
columns.description: Conversion rate used for converting the amount from the entered currency to the ledger currency.

columns.name: ENTER_CURR_UNIT_SELLING_PRICE
columns.description: Unit selling price of the item or memo line in the transaction currency.

columns.name: ENTER_CURR_LINE_AMOUNT
columns.description: Line amount of the promised detail line in the transaction currency.

columns.name: CONTR_CURR_UNIT_SELLING_PRICE
columns.description: Unit selling price of the item or memo line in the accounted currency.

columns.name: CONTR_CURR_LINE_AMOUNT
columns.description: Line amount of the promised detail line in the accounted currency.

columns.name: ENTER_CURR_UNIT_LIST_PRICE_AMT
columns.description: Unit list price amount of the promised detail line.
